name: fetch
doc: Reading a page as text, said once and proved three times.

functions.name: fetch_text
functions.doc:
The body at a URL, as text.

Text means decoded: by the charset the response declares, and as UTF-8 when it declares none. Bytes that are not valid in that charset are a failure, not a guess, and so is a status outside 200 to 299. Saying all this is what lets three proofs be held to one answer, because each platform's shortest way of doing it decides these things differently: Node's `response.text()` ignores the declared charset altogether.

A future, because none of them answers immediately.
